notes_for_editor: Height disagrees: the 1952 survey note gives about 80 ft (record 24.4 m, kept) and the county and state lists give 100 ft; the story says the sources differ. Private property per the county list, so access is recorded as private. No source found on staffing, fires or what remains at the site. The Finland tower (list entry 107) is the same tower before its 1951 move.
